pages.text: LET’S TALK IN THE DEN.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WELL?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: A DRINK, THEN?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BOOZE AT THIS TIME OF DAY?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT’S NOT “BOOZE. IT’S A COCKTAIL. MY NEWEST CONCOCTION.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HAVE A SEAT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU ADD LEMON JUICE AND A DASH OF GINGER TO THE BASE OF VODKA.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE ACHIEVEMENT HERE IS IN THE PROPORTIONS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: PLEASE TRY IT. I HOPE IT’S TO YOUR LIKING.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHY DID YOU PUT THOSE TWO UP TO THAT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AND... WHY DIDN'T I TELL YOU..? WELL, ASH, I WOULDN'T THINK IT NECESSARY TO TROUBLE YOU WITH A MATTER SO TRIVIAL.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU CALL KILLING A MAN TRIVIAL?!

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: PAPA ?!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT’S NOTHING.

pages.speaker: character7
pages.text: ANGIE, TOUSSAINT, YOU BOYS STAY IN THE NEXT ROOM.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: CALM YOURSELF ASH.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: IF IVE PUT YOU OUT IN ANY WAY, APOLOGIZE. I HOPE YOU DON'T THINK THAT I TAKE YOUR POSITION LIGHTLY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT’S NOT WHAT I’M TALKING ABOUT.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: ump

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WE HAD AN AGREEMENT! YOU PROMISED NOT TO USE MY BOYS TO KILL!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THE CIRCUM-STANCES WERE EXTRA-ORDINARY. ANYWAY, HE WASN'T A MEMBER OF THE SYNDICATE. JUST A VERY TINY MOUSE THAT WANTED STEPPING A CHORE FOR POCKET MONEY, AS IT WERE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT’S WHY I’M SURPRISED YOU EVEN CAME TO KNOW ABOUT IT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THEY'D BEEN ACTING STRANGE LATELY, SO I WAS KEEPING TABS

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: ONCE AGAIN, I'VE UNDER-ESTIMATED YOU. AND YET I'VE KNOWN FROM THE START YOU WERE BORN TO LEAD.
